related_questions.question: What is the leading cause of death in Russia?

text_blocks.snippet: In Russia, cardiovascular diseases (CVD) are the leading cause of death. They account for a significant portion of all fatalities, with ischemic heart disease and stroke being major contributors, according to the World Health Organization (WHO). While cardiovascular disease is the top cause, cancer is also a major health concern in Russia, ranking second as a cause of death.
